class.name: MeshConvexDecompositionSettings
class.brief_description: Parameters to be used with a [Mesh] convex decomposition operation.
class.description: Parameters to be used with a [Mesh] convex decomposition operation.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], uses approximation for computing convex hulls.

member.name: convex_hull_downsampling
member.deprecated: Godot: Conservatory Edition - This property is not recommended for use because its name is misleading. The term 'downsampling' implies that greater values reduce quality. They do not. Use [member convex_hull_granularity] instead.

members.member: Controls the precision of the convex-hull generation process during the clipping plane selection stage. Ranges from [code]1[/code] to [code]16[/code].

member.name: max_concavity
member.deprecated: Godot: Conservatory Edition - This name is incorrect due to ambiguous writing in Godot's source code, and it actually represents the [i]minimum[/i] concavity. Use [member min_concavity] instead.

members.member: The minimum amount of concavity that the mesh has. A value of 0 completely disallows concavity, generating a single convex hull. A value of 1 allows preserving the precise shape (limited by the other properties). Ranges from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
The maximum number of convex hulls to produce from the merge operation.
Controls the maximum number of triangles per convex-hull. Ranges from [code]4[/code] to [code]1024[/code].
Controls the adaptive sampling of the generated convex-hulls. Ranges from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]0.01[/code].
Mode for the approximate convex decomposition. Not used in precise mode.
If [code]true[/code], normalizes the mesh before applying the convex decomposition. This may help improve accuracy, in some cases.

member.name: plane_downsampling
member.deprecated: Godot: Conservatory Edition - This property is not recommended for use because its name is misleading. The term 'downsampling' implies that greater values reduce quality. They do not. Use [member plane_granularity] instead.

members.member: Controls the granularity of the search for the "best" clipping plane. Ranges from [code]1[/code] to [code]16[/code].
If [code]true[/code], projects output convex hull vertices onto the original source mesh to increase floating-point accuracy of the results.
Maximum number of voxels generated during the voxelization stage. Ranged from 10000 to 100000.
Controls the bias toward clipping along revolution axes. Ranges from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
Controls the bias toward clipping along symmetry planes. Ranges from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

Controls the precision of the convex-hull generation process during the clipping plane selection stage. Ranges from [code]1[/code] to [code]16[/code]. Higher values result in higher precision decomposition, but take longer to compute.

Controls the granularity of the search for the "best" clipping plane between convex hulls. Ranges from [code]1[/code] to [code]16[/code]. Higher values result in higher precision decomposition, but take longer to compute.

constants.constant: Constant for voxel-based approximate convex decomposition.
Constant for tetrahedron-based approximate convex decomposition.
